title: Knowledge Grapher graph
description: A knowledge graph exported by Knowledge Grapher (knowledge-graph.json): entities and the relations between them. Relations read "from → type → to".

center.description: Id of the entity the graph is about.

id.description: Unique and stable: a lowercase hyphenated slug of the name when created ("Maya Chen" → "maya-chen"). Never changes on rename.

type.description: Lowercase free text, e.g. person, role, project, task, tool, topic, idea, organization, place, resource.

reviewed.description: When the owner last confirmed or edited this entity. Older means less certain.

type.description: Lowercase verb phrase, e.g. "works with", "uses", "part of".

to.description: Id of an existing entity, different from "from".
